text:
The panel unanimously agrees that the scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, with trains running every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; every 6 minutes at peak.

The panel consensus holds that dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU. One dissenting figure of 16.4 metres was attributed to misinterpretation.

Answer: Dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

The three-phase expansion programme will lay a total of 36.7 kilometres of new pipe: 12.4 km in Phase 1 (E3), 8.7 km in Phase 2 (E4), and 15.6 km in Phase 3 (E5).

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

The original public opening was scheduled for 14 September 2026. An 11-week delay (77 days) was announced due to late delivery of the ventilation control system. Adding 77 days to 14 September 2026 gives 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

The panel reached strong consensus. Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: 13.6 mmHg; 19 participants.

The panel unanimously concluded that FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

Answer: 171 mL FVC decline; diarrhoea was the most common adverse event.

Of the 450 participants in the senotrazide arm, 54 discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding a discontinuation rate of 12%.

Answer: 12%

Of the 312 participants randomized to the pelvastrin arm, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24 (60 total non-completers). All remaining participants completed the 24-month follow-up.

Answer: 252

All panelists agree that Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million and that it guided fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million, and it guided fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

The panel reached strong consensus on both figures, with five panelists agreeing on each.

Answer: Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3%, and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, representing an increase of $45 million. The percentage growth is calculated as ($295M − $250M) / $250M = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Using Tamberlin Software's own definition (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures), free cash flow for fiscal 2025 was $87.3 million minus $52.9 million, equaling $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

The panelists unanimously agree that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

Answer: $1.64 million in compensatory damages; no punitive damages awarded.

The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros (E4). The tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros (E7), which fell below the cap. All panelists reached unanimous agreement on both figures.

Answer: The contractual cap was €7.5 million; the tribunal awarded Ventrica €6.9 million.

The settlement agreement's effective date is 18 February 2025. Payment is due no later than 45 calendar days after that date, with the day after the effective date counted as day 1. Counting from 19 February through 28 February (10 days), all of March (31 days, totalling 41), and into April, the 45th day falls on 4 April 2025.

Answer: Tellwright must pay into the tenant compensation fund by 4 April 2025.

The panel unanimously concludes the total amount ordered is $2.88 million, comprising $2.35 million in compensatory damages (already reflecting the 20% contributory negligence reduction), $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable court costs. Attorney's fees are excluded as not recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million.

All panelists agree, citing evidence E4, that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres (E4).

LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm, and test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The panel unanimously determined that the terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 m by 16 years yields an average retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The number of breeding pairs fell from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a decline of 370 pairs. Dividing 370 by the original 1,480 gives a 25% decrease.

Answer: 25%

The panel reached strong consensus that 48,600 patients' records were exposed and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025. One outlier figure of 84,600 was attributed to a transcription error, as all panelists cited the same evidence source.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

The panel reached a strong consensus. Five of six panelists agreed that approximately 340 kilograms of ammonia was released (E3) and that 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight (E5). One panelist's figure of 270 kg was deemed a misreading of the same evidence.

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage lasted 4 hours and 25 minutes, from the first errors at 22:47 UTC on 9 October to the recorded end at 03:12 UTC on 10 October.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

During the incident, 35 minutes × 1,200 checkout attempts per minute = 42,000 total attempts. With a 30% failure rate, 42,000 × 0.30 = 12,600 failed attempts.

Answer: 12,600
